'''Kayen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Invasion of Belsavis]] around [[3641 BBY]] he was stationed in the [[High Security Section]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] when the Empire provoken poisonous local fauna into attacking Republic forces. While treating [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Rachari]], Kayen developed an antidote against the poison, which required the gland samples from the creatures to work. Unable to leave Ensign Rachari's side, Kayen asked a Republic operative in the area to gather the glands and deliver them to [[Private/Legends|Private]] [[Lorul]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Kayen appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Belsavis, who starts the mission "Emergent Medicine."
